title: Agentic AI Empowered Intent-Based Networking for 6G

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating agent-generated network configurations against expert-defined 'Golden Standard' benchmarks (Semantic Accuracy) and a quantitative technical optimality score (Engineering Utility), followed by manual inspection of reasoning traces to identify systematic decision-making deviations (specifically a 'latency greedy' bias caused by weak directive language in prompts).
